notes: This contract directly traces HLAobjectInstancesDeleted to its pinned standard MIM entry, the standard Delete Object Instance service, and IEEE 1516.1 clauses 11.4.1 and 6.17. Installed-package runs are bounded provider evidence, not proof of provider-independent behavior or conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard MIM defines HLAobjectInstancesDeleted as the total number of Delete Object Instance service invocations by the represented joined federate since Join and declares the attribute periodic under HLAsetTiming. The scenario checks zero before deletion, one and two after the first two successful invocations, and three through an actual periodic reflection after the third invocation, before issuing its final direct request.

The joined publisher invokes the standard receive-order Delete Object Instance service for each registered application instance; each successful call is checked against exactly one receiver-side removeObjectInstance callback with the supplied tag and publisher handle.
